raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the thermodynamics of the observation. External droplets freezing indicates the beaker became very cold because the reaction absorbed heat from its surroundings. Although freezing releases latent heat, that heat is being drawn into the cold beaker and consumed by the reaction. Thus the reaction is endothermic (energy absorbed), not exothermic.
